title: Recommended!
text: Recommended!. I chose to test these with cookies (of course!).  I didn't spray the pan with anything, just dropped the cooking in the pan and baked.  They didn't stick at all. I wiped out the pan and put in some empanadas.  I went about my business and forgot I was cooking.  When I remembered some of the juices had leaked out of the empanadas and burned under them.  No problem, the empanadas and the burned juices, came right off of the pan.  No scrubbing or anything to get the burn off.  The burnt juiced stuck to the empanadas, not the pan.Definitely no stick, without the nasty teflon coating!  I recommend!

description: Get good and delicious even before baking begins, with the sturdy design and sweet nonstick action of the durable, reliable Circulon® Total™ Nonstick Bakeware 6-Piece Set. Superior nonstick technology and solution-driven design set Circulon® bakeware apart from other nonstick bakeware. The technology begins with raised circles on the baking surface that are coated with premium-quality nonstick. The rolled-rim bakeware design includes wide handles for plenty of grip, even with bulky oven mitts. Blend all this together, and that’s the recipe for lifelong baking enjoyment, whether you’re a frequent cake maker or just a once-in-a-while cookie baker. Once the baking’s done, all that exceptional nonstick technology keeps the cleanup easy. The set includes a pair of round cake pans, perfect for layer cakes made from mixes as well as from scratch. The square and rectangular cake pans are ideal for more than sheet cakes and brownies—they're handy for baked casseroles, weekend frittatas, and more. The loaf pan and medium cookie sheet are great for baking treats as well as meals, like lean and savory turkey meatloaf or mini-pizzas for the kids' dinner. Oven safe to 450°F with a Hassle-Free Lifetime Guarantee, this bakeware brings the Circulon® kitchen-time-and-energy-saving approach to baking home. Get set for more deliciousness, with more convenience and less hassle, with the Circulon® Total™ Nonstick Bakeware 6-Piece Bakeware Set, the perfect partnership of baking pan and performance.
